sections.name: Verse 1
lines: We would trust the One who knows
All our weak and failing powers.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Like the dawning of fair morn
Come thy hours to us again.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: Welcome, day blessed by our Lord!
Toil shall cease and anxious care.
Day for song and praise and prayer.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: Day God bids us ne'er forget,
Day of days His name to bless.
